title: Lakefront Brewery Beer Hall

services.name: Dive Beer
services.desc: Explore Lakefront's lineup of beer available year-round, including some of our most-loved and most-sought brews of all time. No matter the time of year, we’ve got beers that celebrate the flavors of each season. You’re sure to find the perfect pairing, no matter the weather. Whether seeking out a one-and-done from our Brewers' Series, a Beer Hall-only draft, or something even more far out, Limited Release is where you’ll find it. Tastebuds set on a specific style? Select a favorite and find exactly what you’re looking for in our collection of industrious and inventive craft

gap: Price ranges for food and drinks not stated
blurb: The Beer Hall offers counter service with first come, first served open seating and no reservations needed. It operates 7 days a week with a daily menu and a Friday lunch menu. The patio is available for walk-up seating with beer service during summer months and a weekend CurdWagon providing patio eats.
